purpose: Machine-readable operational argument documentation for HB Foundry capabilities. These contracts describe the canonical existing functions; they do not reimplement them.

convention.singleObject: For global-method capabilities the facade passes the documented input object as the single function argument.
convention.dispatcher: For global-dispatch capabilities call HBFoundryAPI.invoke(capabilityId, {operation, args:[...]}); args are positional in the exact documented order.
convention.unknownFields: Object operations may accept additional fields used by the canonical engine. Documented fields are the supported public integration surface; adapters should not invent undocumented values.
convention.returns: Return descriptions identify the canonical output class and important fields, not a replacement implementation schema.

arguments.name: input
arguments.description: Semantic site generation request. Omission generates the canonical generic site with dynamic default seed/module profile behavior.

seed.description: Deterministic generation seed. When omitted, the module generator derives module-map:<normalized archetype> for topology/site-profile generation.

locationArchetype.description: Canonical site program. Unknown values normalize to generic; documented aliases are accepted by the runtime.

width.description: Requested topology grid width. Baseline is 72 before semantic capacity expansion; layout.gridWidth, when supplied, has final precedence over this top-level value.

height.description: Requested topology grid height. Baseline is 56 before semantic capacity expansion; layout.gridHeight, when supplied, has final precedence over this top-level value.

deck.description: Deck rendered into the returned editor cell map; full multi-deck layout remains in spatialLayout.

roles.description: Explicit semantic room-role program. When non-empty it replaces archetype default roles before topology generation.

role.description: Semantic role; type is an alias used by the spatial engine.

adjacency.description: Semantic adjacency constraints. Two-item arrays mean required a/b links; object constraints may use a/b or from/to plus optional id, kind, and required=false.

applySiteLayersToCustomRoles.description: Custom-role policy switch. false keeps custom roles/adjacency and applies site layers as context only; true permits full semantic site-layer mutation of the custom program.

semanticMutationEnabled.description: For built-in archetype programs, false disables layered semantic role mutations while retaining resolved site context. Custom-role programs use applySiteLayersToCustomRoles as the authoritative mutation switch.

siteScale.description: Semantic site scale. Alias pair with scale; values come from the canonical site option catalog.

originCulture.description: Original construction/cultural influence from the canonical site option catalog.

controller.description: Current site controller/occupant authority from the canonical site option catalog.

currentController.description: Alias for controller; also used as a faction fallback for content population.

occupancyState.description: Current occupancy state from the canonical site option catalog.

biome.description: Biome from the canonical site option catalog.

climate.description: Climate from the canonical site option catalog.

season.description: Season from the canonical site option catalog.

weather.description: Weather from the canonical site option catalog.

ecology.description: Ecology from the canonical site option catalog.

wealth.description: Wealth/resource condition from the canonical site option catalog.

security.description: Security posture from the canonical site option catalog.

age.description: Site age from the canonical site option catalog.

condition.description: Structural/site condition from the canonical site option catalog.

magicTech.description: Magic/technology profile from the canonical site option catalog.

lighting.description: Lighting condition from the canonical site option catalog.

waterState.description: Water/moisture condition from the canonical site option catalog.

verticality.description: Vertical organization from the canonical site option catalog.

secretDensity.description: Secret-space density from the canonical site option catalog.

traffic.description: Traffic/activity level from the canonical site option catalog.

socialMode.description: Social-use mode from the canonical site option catalog.

resourceProfile.description: Dominant site resource profile from the canonical site option catalog.

maintenance.description: Maintenance state from the canonical site option catalog.

contamination.description: Contamination state from the canonical site option catalog.

defenseDoctrine.description: Defense doctrine from the canonical site option catalog.

narrativeTone.description: Narrative/social tone from the canonical site option catalog.

creatureFamilies.description: Explicit creature-family set. Values come from the canonical site option catalog.

hazardFamilies.description: Explicit hazard-family set. Values come from the canonical site option catalog.

materials.description: Explicit material palette. Values come from the canonical site option catalog.

creatureDensity.description: Creature-population intensity; omitted values are deterministically resolved from the site-profile seed.

hazardIntensity.description: Site-profile hazard intensity; omitted values are deterministically resolved from the site-profile seed and also inform content danger when dangerLevel is omitted.

treasureDensity.description: Treasure/resource discovery density; omitted values are deterministically resolved from the site-profile seed.

socialDensity.description: Social encounter/activity density; omitted values are deterministically resolved from the site-profile seed.

preferences.description: Axis-keyed site-profile preferences. Each axis preference may contain include, exclude, and preferred arrays; preferred values are weighted rather than mandatory.

explicit.description: Advanced axis-keyed explicit override object consumed by the canonical site-profile resolver.

layout.description: Shared semantic spatial-engine placement overrides. gridWidth/gridHeight override top-level width/height when both are supplied.

pruneDeadEnds.description: Layout-level pruning gate; either top-level or layout-level false disables pruning.

extraEdgeChance.description: Additional same-deck topology edge probability. When omitted, the layered site-profile value is used; its baseline is 0.18 and semantic layers may adjust it.

pruneDeadEnds.description: Dead-end pruning is enabled unless explicitly false. layout.pruneDeadEnds=false also disables pruning.

strict.description: Strict spatial validation is enabled unless explicitly false. Validation failure throws before a result is returned.

contentSeed.description: Optional independent deterministic seed for semantic content population. When omitted, the topology seed is reused when present.

dangerLevel.description: Content-population danger context; hazardIntensity/site context is used when omitted.

faction.description: Faction context for populated content. Falls back through currentController/controller/site profile.

adventurePurpose.description: Adventure/scene purpose used by content population and semantic objectives.

damageState.description: Damage/access condition string used by content population. The canonical content layer string-normalizes this value; structured damage objects are not part of this public contract.

rulesTarget.description: Canonical compatibility target for populated content. Known human-readable aliases are normalized by the content authority; unknown values fall back to open_d20.

returns.description: Module-map editor record containing schemaVersion/tool/generator, width/height/tileSize/cells, seed/deck/deckCount, full spatialLayout with validation, semanticProgram, resolved siteProfile, populated content, compatibility, provenance, title, and notes.

arguments.name: input
arguments.description: Alien vessel generation request. Built-in profiles define the semantic compartment program; additional roles/adjacency extend rather than replace it.

seed.description: Deterministic vessel seed. When omitted the generator derives alien-vessel:<profile>, using recon when profile is omitted.

profile.description: Built-in semantic vessel profile. Public integrations should use the documented enum; the runtime falls back to recon topology for unknown internal values.

vesselType.description: Returned vessel-type label; does not replace the semantic profile program.

decks.description: Override the deck count. When omitted it is derived from the highest deck referenced by the selected and additional roles; both built-in profiles currently resolve to three decks.

width.description: Requested topology width before layout overrides. layout.gridWidth has final precedence when both are supplied.

height.description: Requested topology height before layout overrides. layout.gridHeight has final precedence when both are supplied.

additionalRoles.description: Additional semantic compartments appended to the selected profile before topology generation.

role.description: Semantic role; type is an alias used by the spatial engine.

deck.description: A deck above an explicit decks override may cause strict spatial validation to fail.

adjacency.description: Additional semantic adjacency constraints appended to the selected profile. Two-item arrays mean required links; object constraints may use a/b or from/to plus optional id, kind, and required=false.

layout.description: Shared spatial-engine placement overrides. These values are applied after the Alien Vessel defaults and therefore have final precedence.

pruneDeadEnds.description: Layout-level pruning gate; either top-level or layout-level false disables pruning.
Dead-end pruning is enabled unless explicitly false; layout.pruneDeadEnds=false also disables pruning.

strict.description: Spatial and hull validation are strict unless explicitly false. Spatial validation failure throws in the shared engine; hull validation failure throws in the vessel generator.

hullShape.description: Canonical hull-envelope shape. Runtime aliases include skin/connected/organic, ellipse/elliptical, pill, rectangular/box, cube/cubic, and circular/cylinder/cylindrical; unknown values normalize to connected-skin.

shape.description: Alias for hullShape. hullShape has precedence when both are supplied.

hullTightness.description: Hull clearance selector. Named presets: skin-tight=1, tight=2, close=3, standard=4, loose=7, very-loose=10 cells. Numeric 0..1 maps from 10 toward 1 cells as the value increases; other finite numbers are rounded and clamped to 1..24 cells.

tightness.description: Alias for hullTightness. hullTightness has precedence when both are supplied.

damageSeverity.description: Deterministic room-damage annotation intensity, clamped by the runtime to 0..1. If omitted, damaged_recon uses 0.65 and recon uses 0. Damage selection uses the vessel seed with a :damage suffix and avoids most critical rooms probabilistically.

returns.description: Alien vessel record containing schemaVersion/generator, vesselType, faction, profile, final seed/deckCount, semanticSummary, canonical hull envelope with normalized shape/tightness/clearance and validation, deterministic damage annotations, full spatialLayout, and combined spatial/hull validation.

arguments.name: input
arguments.description: Kaysender airship generation request. Vessel class and hull culture select canonical size/deck/room/hull defaults; textual mission, cargo, armament, defense, condition, legal, core, crew, and faction fields add semantic compartments and content context.

seed.description: Deterministic topology seed. When omitted the generator derives kaysender:<name-or-vesselClass-or-airship>:<cultureKey>.

name.description: Returned vessel name and, when seed is omitted, the preferred seed-name component.

vesselClass.description: Class text selects default deck count, map size, cargo-room multiplicity, and berth baseline. dreadnought -> 4 decks/108x78; galleon/cruiser/destroyer -> 3/96x70; frigate/liner/salvage barge -> 3/88x64; corvette/merchant sloop/pirate raider -> 2/80x58; other -> 2/72x52.

hullCulture.description: Culture text normalizes to dwarven, elven, dragon_kin, gnomish, human, halfling, pirate, guild, military, or ancient. The culture adds canonical rooms/adjacency and supplies default hull shape, room-size bounds, and extra-edge probability.

coreType.description: Core text may add fuel-handling, ritual/attunement, elemental-control, calibration, quarantine, or concealed-bypass compartments.

purpose.description: Operational purpose influences mission/cargo specialist spaces and is the content adventure-purpose fallback when currentMission is absent.

currentMission.description: Specific current mission used as the preferred content-population adventure purpose; it does not replace the returned purpose field.

crewScale.description: Crew text adjusts habitation berth multiplicity: 120+ -> 4; 50-120/25-50/overcrowded -> 3; 12-25 -> 2; otherwise class baseline.

cargoProfile.description: Cargo text may add cistern, passenger/evacuee, salvage-processing, contraband, medical, or ordnance specialist compartments.

armament.description: Unarmed text suppresses the armory. Cannon/ballista/lance/torpedo/siege/gun/boarding text additionally creates a weapons station.

condition.description: Condition text drives deterministic damage severity and default content danger. Severity mapping: pristine/well maintained=0; worn=.15; battle=.35; storm=.45; patched=.5; sputtering=.55; fatigue/unsafe/miraculously=.65; other=.2. Damage-state role insertion uses the damaged-condition text family.

legalStatus.description: Forged/pirate/wanted/secret/impounded/unregistered text adds a concealed registry cache; naval/mercenary text adds an orders/security room.

factionAffiliation.description: Preferred faction context. Non-local-merchant faction text may add a secure faction-liaison compartment; also used for content population and returned affiliation.

factionEntanglement.description: Fallback faction context when factionAffiliation is absent.

decks.description: Override class-derived deck count. Culture-specific built-in roles are clamped to the class deck count before this override; custom additional role deck values are not automatically rewritten.

width.description: Override class-derived topology width before layout overrides. layout.gridWidth has final precedence.

height.description: Override class-derived topology height before layout overrides. layout.gridHeight has final precedence.

additionalRoles.description: Additional semantic compartments appended after class/culture/program roles.

role.description: Semantic role; type is an alias used by the spatial engine.

adjacency.description: Additional semantic adjacency constraints appended after class/culture/program adjacency. Two-item arrays mean required links; engine object constraints may use a/b or from/to.

layout.description: Shared spatial-engine placement overrides applied after class/culture defaults and therefore given final precedence.

minRoomWidth.description: Culture-derived default: dwarven 6, elven 7, dragon_kin 6, gnomish 5, human 6, halfling 7, pirate 5, guild 6, military 5, ancient 6.

maxRoomWidth.description: Culture-derived default: dwarven 12, elven 13, dragon_kin 13, gnomish 11, human 12, halfling 14, pirate 12, guild 12, military 11, ancient 14.

minRoomHeight.description: Culture-derived default: dwarven 5, elven 6, dragon_kin 5, gnomish 5, human 5, halfling 6, pirate 5, guild 5, military 5, ancient 5.

maxRoomHeight.description: Culture-derived default: dwarven 10, elven 11, dragon_kin 10, gnomish 9, human 10, halfling 11, pirate 10, guild 10, military 9, ancient 11.

extraEdgeChance.description: Override culture-derived additional edge probability. Culture defaults: dwarven .08, elven .22, dragon_kin .10, gnomish .27, human .16, halfling .24, pirate .25, guild .14, military .06, ancient .20.

pruneDeadEnds.description: Dead-end pruning is enabled unless explicitly false; layout.pruneDeadEnds=false also disables pruning.

strict.description: Passed to the shared spatial engine; spatial validation is strict unless explicitly false. The Kaysender adapter reports hull validation in the returned validation object rather than adding Alien Vessel's separate strict hull throw.

hullShape.description: Override culture-derived hull shape. Culture defaults: dwarven rectangle, elven oval, dragon_kin capsule, gnomish connected-skin, human capsule, halfling oval, pirate connected-skin, guild rectangle, military rectangle, ancient connected-skin. Hull adapter aliases normalize as documented by its authority.

hullTightness.description: Hull clearance selector passed to the canonical hull adapter. This adapter uses hullTightness || standard, so falsy values including numeric 0 fall back to standard. Named and numeric normalization otherwise follows vessel-hull-envelope.js.

contentSeed.description: Independent content-population seed. When omitted, the original input seed is passed; if both are absent, the content authority uses its own deterministic default rather than the derived topology seed.

dangerLevel.description: Content-population danger override. When omitted, canonical condition severity derives max(3,min(9,4+round(severity*6))); worn default resolves to 5.

returns.description: Kaysender airship record containing schemaVersion/generator/version, final deterministic seed, identity/profile fields, normalized cultureKey, deckCount, semanticSummary, full spatialLayout with attached Kaysender semanticProgram, canonical hull envelope, deterministic condition-driven damage annotations, populated Kaysender content, compatibility, provenance including adapter/sourceProfileType, and combined spatial/hull validation.
